faces.name: Jace, Reality Sculptor
faces.oracleText:
+1: Empower Jace X, where X is the number of Islands you control.
−3: Until your next turn, whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, it gets -5/-0 until end of turn.
0: Exile all but the bottom card of each opponent's library. Activate only if there are twenty-five or more loyalty counters among Jaces you control.

faces.name: Jace Reawakened
faces.oracleText:
You can't cast Jace Reawakened during your first, second, or third turns of the game.
+1: Draw a card, then discard a card.
+1: You may exile a nonland card with mana value 3 or less from your hand. If you do, it becomes plotted.
−6: Until end of turn, whenever you cast a spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.

faces.name: Jace's Archivist
faces.oracleText: {U}, {T}: Each player discards their hand, then draws cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.

faces.name: Jace's Bloomburrow
faces.oracleText:
Creatures you control with power 4 or greater can't be blocked by creatures with lesser power.
As an additional cost to cast creature spells, you may pay {3}. If you do, when that creature enters, it bites target creature an opponent controls. (It deals damage equal to its power to that creature.)
Whenever chaos ensues, each creature your opponents control has base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.

faces.name: Jace's Capenna
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.
Whenever an Angel dies, its controller chooses up to one target noncreature permanent. Destroy it.
Whenever chaos ensues, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying for each time the planar die was rolled this turn.

faces.name: Jace's Defeat
faces.oracleText: Counter target blue spell. If it was a Jace planeswalker spell, scry 2.

faces.name: Jace's Erasure
faces.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, you may have target player mill a card.
